title: SarnautCore ability (minimal)
description: A deliberately minimal ability record. It exists because ADR 0032 puts starting_abilities on the chargen document and requires the compiler's cross-reference pass to resolve those ids, and because spawn mob documents already carry an abilities list. Full ability and spell extraction is queued per ADR 0003; M2's single ability is a curated overlay document, so this schema fixes only what M2 reads: identity, targeting, cost in time, and one damage effect. Adding fields later is additive; guessing at them now is not.

target.description: M2 has no self-targeted, friendly or ground-targeted abilities (ADR 0032); the enum records that rather than leaving it implicit.

range_m.description: Maximum caster-to-target distance. Units are metres by assumption; combat.md section 7.2 records that the retail unit is unverified.
